sentences.en: My interest in languages shows some variation and cyclical patterns.
sentences.zh: 我对语言的兴趣显示出一些变化和周期性模式。

sentences.en: Obviously there are many variations between these two extremes.
sentences.zh: 显然，这两者之间存在许多差异。

sentences.en: This is the humorous variation of a certain proverb.
sentences.zh: 这是一则某个谚语的幽默变体版本。

senses.zh: 变化, 变动(的程度) - 变奏(曲) - 变异, 变种 形容词: variational

mnemonic: 词根记忆：vari（改变）+ation（表状态）→变化，变动，变异
